mechanistic_claim_tested: Moyamoya is a congenital FA malformation rather than acquired
key_finding: First FA+moyamoya case; right-sided moyamoya pattern; authors suggest congenital FA vascular anomaly beyond bleeding tendency
confidence_and_limitations: Very low (n=1); no molecular data; pre-transplant era

mechanistic_claim_tested: FANCC genotype predisposes to primary congenital vascular anomaly
key_finding: 2/434 FA patients with moyamoya; both compound heterozygous FANCC 322delG+R185X, absent in 174 other families
column9: single genotype); RNF213 not tested; strongest direct support

mechanistic_claim_tested: Moyamoya in FA is treatable but FA worsens outcome
key_finding: 1 FA child within 30-child moyamoya surgical cohort; died of FA 7 yr post-EDAS
confidence_and_limitations: Very low (n=1); incidental within a surgical series

mechanistic_claim_tested: FA-moyamoya is a rare congenital defect
key_finding: 10-yr-old with FA and moyamoya; moyamoya diagnosed before SCT; died post-SCT
confidence_and_limitations: Very low (n=1); seed reference; no mechanism proposed

mechanistic_claim_tested: Uncertain whether moyamoya is FA malformation or bleeding sequela
key_finding: 9-yr-old FA with right ICA stenosis + basal-ganglia collaterals; authors question congenital vs bleeding etiology
confidence_and_limitations: Very low (n=1); explicitly raises alternative (recurrent bleeding)

mechanistic_claim_tested: Moyamoya is not part of the recognized FA malformation spectrum
key_finding: VACTERL-H (8 features) defined; moyamoya not listed; VACTERL-H in 33% of FA (18/54, P<0.0001)
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate; defines canonical anomaly set that excludes moyamoya

mechanistic_claim_tested: FA structural anomalies map to specific complexes
key_finding: ID complex assoc with VACTERL-H; upstream complex less severe, lacked VACTERL-H (n=203)

mechanistic_claim_tested: Hyperactive TGF-beta drives FA progenitor attrition
key_finding: Genome-wide shRNA screen: TGF-beta growth suppression causes BMF; inhibition rescues HSPC survival
confidence_and_limitations: High for HSPC; NOT shown in vascular cells

key_finding: Fancd2-/- embryos gain genomic instability; Fancd2-/-Smad3-/- high embryonic lethality via TGFbeta-NHEJ

mechanistic_claim_tested: TP53-dependent apoptosis of progenitors underlies IBMFS
key_finding: Overarching model: stresses elicit TP53 growth arrest/apoptosis of stem/progenitor cells

mechanistic_claim_tested: Radiation arteritis is radiologically distinct from idiopathic moyamoya
key_finding: Radiation-induced arteritis shows prominent wall ring enhancement vs moyamoya (P=0.003)

mechanistic_claim_tested: Cranial irradiation causes dose-dependent cerebral vasculopathy
key_finding: Cerebrovascular toxicity 0.2% at 30Gy, 1.3% at 45Gy, 4.4% at 54Gy to circle of Willis
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate-high; iatrogenic alternative to intrinsic FA arteriopathy

mechanistic_claim_tested: Transplant-conditioning cranial irradiation can cause moyamoya
key_finding: Moyamoya 1.5 yr after cranial irradiation for BMT
confidence_and_limitations: Low (n=1); relevant to transplanted FA patients

mechanistic_claim_tested: RNF213 loss drives angiogenesis + VSMC phenotype switch
key_finding: RNF213 knockdown promotes EC proliferation/migration/angiogenesis via JAK2/STAT3, VSMC switching
RNF213-RNAi impairs EC angiogenesis; EC-VSMC crosstalk key; patient vessel arrays altered
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate; competing mechanistic model with human-tissue data

mechanistic_claim_tested: RNF213 is the principal moyamoya susceptibility gene
key_finding: RNF213 sole reported gene (GCST000860); no FA gene at any moyamoya locus (this analysis)
confidence_and_limitations: High for common-variant; cannot capture rare Mendelian FA co-segregation

mechanistic_claim_tested: FA genes expressed in artery (necessary condition)
key_finding: FA-pathway genes expressed in artery but mid/low percentile; RNF213 artery-high (50-78 pct)
confidence_and_limitations: Weak/non-specific; bulk not single-cell; non-FA donors; no cerebral artery
